ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR43] Requires Up-Sell Quantity while in Solutioning, Negotiation or Booking Verification, for cross-sell/upsell deals. Stage updated 2026-09-24 per IRM.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity' ),
ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ),
OR(ISBLANK(IM_Up_Sell_Quantity__c), IM_Up_Sell_Quantity__c <= 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Up-Sell Quantity is required to advance to the next stage. Please enter a value.
